instruction: Community center IFC model. Create a two-storey community center from scratch in Revit and export it to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc using the IFC4 schema. The program should include a central atrium, classrooms, a maker room, gallery spaces, a toilet, and two roof elements. The IFC must contain one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, two IfcBuildingStorey entities, seven IfcSpace objects, eight IfcWall elements, five IfcSlab elements, and two IfcRoof elements. Name the spaces so they include at least two Classroom spaces, one Maker space, one Lobby, one Toilet, and two Gallery spaces. Include at least five IfcDoor elements, eight IfcWindow elements, and two IfcStair elements. Do not include IfcBuildingElementProxy, IfcColumn, or IfcBeam entities. Size the shaped model so it spans 20.0-24.0 m in X, 18.5-22.0 m in Y, and 6.7-8.0 m in Z. Nonrequired atrium proportions, finishes, and roof forms may vary, but all IfcRoot GlobalIds must be unique.
